testcase.name: Scenario: Capture an active window preview before saving: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-saving-source/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:144:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Capture an active window preview before saving ✔ Given the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user presses Control+S to open Save As ✔ And the Save As dialog is open for a new empty part in the MCAD Software ✔ And Save Preview Picture is selected ✔ When the user chooses Active Window as the preview source ✔ Then a capture control appears beside Active Window ✔ And the preview area displays a placeholder ✔ When the user activates the capture control ✔ Then the preview area displays a dark image matching the empty workspace ✔ And the Save As dialog remains open ✔ When the user cancels the dialog ✔ Then the unsaved part remains active
